title: Velator is live from now on
author: ashishkaloge
selftext:
What's open right now?  
Build your own strategy and backtest it, free  
Browse all 21 strategies in the catalog (7 are Free)  
Paper trading across the catalog simulated, no real funds

What's still off?  
Live exchange trading  
Plans aren't purchasable yet

This is a staged rollout, not a final state. more opens as testing clears.

[https://velator.ai](https://velator.ai)

What's the first thing you'd want to check before trusting a strategy with real money?

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: how many versions got tried before the one being shown. a catalog strategy that was the best of 200 variants tells you very little, and that number almost never gets published.
